profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Over 30+ years of professional software development experience ranging from requirements gathering to mission critical application code to architectural design of highly scalable systems.  I'm a firm believer in TDD,  testing in general, and follow the agile methodology.

Currently working at Sincro Digital and run a small acoustic guitar building business Yzzy Guitar Works. 

Before the pandemic I mentored college interns every year.  We teach them what it means to be a professional software engineer and fill in the gaps that school does not teach them.

For the 2016 CDK Hack-a-thon we built a Portal Turret with an Adrunio boards controlling servos with motion, light, and sound detectors.  Here is a video I mage of the project.  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v24wBieWZsU

Java, AngularJS, TypeScript, Objective C, C++, SQL, NoSQL, Cassandra, Springframework, Hibernate, Hadoop, Maven, Scrum, iOS, Xcode, Eclipse, IntelliJ

Do you know how manually to find the 5th root of 2,738,234?  Me either.  I look it up or use a calculator.  So why do interviewers still ask "what the optimal algorithm for sorting a list?".   Really?  This is the question you have for me?  Here are the answers: http://bigocheatsheet.com/

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: I started modifying and making guitars a few years ago.  Now I have a business making acoustic guitars.

positions.title: Advisory Engineer & Craftsman
positions.description:
* Responsible for 1M+ lines of Java, JS, and SQL code.
* Lead team to refactor our monolithic under-performing application into highly scalable discrete applications and services. 
* Refactoring synchronous architecture to an event based asynchronous architecture.
* Instrumented campaign generation and dealization code and build monitoring dashboards with transparency charts to monitor health and throughput.
* Developed highly scalable and robust rendering and deliverability system for customer notifications.
* Mentored and lead team members in design and development and philosophy of software methodology.
* Worked closely with product owners and stake holders to deliver new features and applications to satisfy business needs.
* Introduced Agile Scrum to our development process.
* Migrated core business logic from database stored procedures to a Java based n-tier, scalable, enterprise architecture.
* Developed application to manage lead prospects and integrated into existing system.
* Designed and implemented company wide services for web based image capturing.
* Increased test coverage for existing code and introduced policy for 100% test coverage for all new code.
* Implemented continuous integration and continuous deployment of production code.
* Maintained high code quality and zero production rollbacks and zero P1 defects.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer/CTO
positions.description:
http://www.metachi.com

Built a mobile first, enterprise grade, work management (orchestration) solution designed to efficiently save, time managing your business, so that you can focus on not only today, but growing your business into the future.

Written for 50,000+ lines of Java, JS, and TypeScript code.

Complete system architect, engineer, tester. 

AngularJS 4
Typescript
Java 8
MongoDB

positions.title: Consulant
positions.description: Created iOS version of BeNote, a best practices business note application targeted for the iPad and cross interoperability for android.

positions.title: Senior Java Engineer
positions.description:
*  Senior Java developer, Core Activities and Infrastructure
    * Designed, implemented, and maintained services that empower content providers and network operators facilitate the management, merchandising and delivery of digital goods and services.
    * Assisted the professional services and operations organization with the deployment and configuration of applications in the production environment.
    * Lead major refactoring effort in core produce to provide logging, monitoring, and traceability
    * Facilitated system upgrade including helper applications to ease upgrade process, documentation, and support

positions.title: Java developer
positions.description:
*  Lead Java developer
    * Designed and built a Model-View-Controller (MVC) framework to enable multiple, simultaneous users to view and update client heath care information view the web
         o Java Servlets with XML Schema and a "rules-action" based paradigm as the controller
         o Java Servlets with XSL and XML as the view
         o Standard JavaBeans as the model 
    * Designed and implemented a standalone business tier via EJB 2.0 and J2EE design patters (such as DTO, DAO, fast lane reader, facades, visitors, etc)
         o SOAP is the current protocol 
    * Mentored and coached peer developers in object oriented design and programming
    * Wrote a company wide build site via XSL and JSP
          o Expose development's internal processes to test, program management, etc
          o Organized the official and nightly builds in an easy to navigate web site.
          o Included JUnit test results, documentation, and Perforce changes history and source logs

positions.title: Java developer
positions.description:
*  Designed and built numerous J2SE and J2EE applications for hosted multi-tiered e-commerce web sites
    * Wrote a multi-threaded backend transaction workflow manager via JMS and EJB
    * Interacted directly with clients, program managers, and peer developers from initial requirements gathering though project completion and post-delivery support
    * Member of architectural team
    * Member of Vitessa employee advisory council

positions.title: Aeroelastian
positions.description:
*  Applied new software techniques to study and validate aircraft dynamics
    * Practiced theoretical and analytical structural dynamics as applied to flexible aircraft
    * Participated in ground vibration testing and flight flutter testing and analysis
    * Wrote lots of FAA documentation
